To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the logic families with minimum variability are the ones that offer the minimum power dissipation.
the most power efficient and robust circuit is the one designed with 2-input NAND/AND gates.
the logic families offering minimum variability and power dissipation are the ones with the highest ratio of the input capacitance (C _{i} ) to the output capacitance (C0) (C _{i0} ).
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions:
1. How does the technology node affect the power and variability of logic families?

the following objectives: (1) to perform power and delay analysis of the most commonly used CMOS logic families (2) to perform power, delay and variability analysis of NAND/AND logic circuits using the most popular logic families (3) to identify the logic families offering minimum variability and minimum power dissipation.

the following: (a) Power analysis and comparison of the most popular logic families in 22 nm CMOS technology node. (b) Variability analysis and comparison of NAND/AND logic circuits in 22 nm technology. (c) Identification of the best logic family for designing ultralow-power and robust circuits in 22nm CMOS technology node.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CMOS logic families are not equally good in terms of variability, and the designer should choose the logic family that best fits the requirements.
NAND2 and AND2 are the best logic families for the design of low power circuits and circuits requiring minimum variability respectively in 22 nm technology.
the NAND family offers the minimum power consumption and the minimum spread of the delay, while the NOR family offers the minimum variability in the delay.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the logic family offering minimum power and minimum variability is the one with the highest number of inputs.
the logic family that offers the minimum power dissipation also offers minimum variability.
the logic families offering minimum variability are the ones offering minimum power dissipaion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the logic family offering minimum power dissipated and variability in a circuit can change with the scaling of the technology node.
the logic family with minimum power dissipation is not necessarily the logic family offering minimum variability and vice-versa.

for a given technology node, the best logic family for a specific design metric can be identified and can be used to design circuits with minimum power dissipation, minimum variability and/or minimum delay.
